name: noulo-router
description: Routes each prompt to a Claude model tier chosen by a local noulo instance: noulo classifies the task and Claude delegates to a stronger model's subagent when the task needs it.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: auto: Claude hands a task to a stronger tier's subagent when noulo says it needs one. suggest: only show noulo's tier and the command that switches to it. off: don't route.

url.title: noulo URL
url.description: The noulo instance that makes routing decisions (a separate one from your other noulo work).
